description:
Search the user's Garmin activities (all history, from the local cache), newest first by default.

Returns one page of compact summaries plus the total number of matches: id, date, type, name, duration, distance, pace/speed, HR, power, elevation, training effect, training load, TSS/IF and VO2max where available, plus time in HR/power zones (JSON mode).

Examples:
  - "My runs this month" -> activity_type="running", start_date="2026-10-01"
  - "Longest rides ever" -> activity_type="cycling", sort_by="distance"
  - "Zwift sessions" -> activity_type="virtual_ride"
  - "Triathlon bike legs" -> include_multisport_legs=true, activity_type="road_biking"

The cache refreshes automatically when it's more than an hour old. Use garmin_get_activity for one activity's full details (splits, FTP, workout).

activity_type.description: Garmin activity type or parent type. Parent types include their subtypes: running (trail_running, treadmill_running, track_running, virtual_run), cycling (road_biking, virtual_ride, indoor_cycling, mountain_biking, gravel_cycling), swimming (lap_swimming, open_water_swimming), walking, hiking, multi_sport, fitness_equipment (strength_training, indoor_cardio, indoor_rowing), racket_sports, water_sports, other.

end_date.description: Only activities on or before this local date, yyyy-MM-dd

include_multisport_legs.description: false (default): multisport activities appear once, as the parent. true: show their individual legs (swim/bike/run/transitions) instead of the parent, e.g. so triathlon bike legs count as cycling volume. Never double counts.

offset.description: Number of activities to skip, for pagination

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for complete structured data

search.description: Text to match in the activity name (case-insensitive)

start_date.description: Only activities on or after this local date, yyyy-MM-dd

name: garmin_list_activities
title: List Garmin activities
